notes: No verifiable current menu. No own website, no first-party ordering page and no live delivery-marketplace store page was found for 700 Bellwood Ave. The NetWaiter page (https://montegobay.netwaiter.com/bellwood/about/ - address 700 Bellwood Ave, (708) 547-4625) has hours only, no menu. Two third-party directory listings for this address do carry a priced menu, but both look stale and were NOT used: (1) SinglePlatform, https://places.singleplatform.com/montego-bay-restaurant/menu - unclaimed ('claim this menu'), undated, shows the old phone 708-547-7911, sections Jerk Wings / Seafood Entrées / Dinner Entrees / Side Orders / Beverages (e.g. Red Snapper $12.00, King Fish $12.00, Jerk Chicken Dark $10.98, Jerk Chicken Mixed $9.50, Rice & Beans $2.50–$4.50) with an internal inconsistency (3 Wings $7.13 vs 6 Wings $6.25). (2) FoodBoss, https://www.foodboss.com/chicago-il/montego-bay-restaurant-700-bellwood-ave-bellwood-delivery - a fuller version of the same menu (adds Oxtail $11.00, Curry Goat $10.50, Brown Stew Chicken $9.50, Curry Chicken $9.50, Beef Patties $2.25, Plantains $1.50), sourced from a Postmates listing and marked 'Last updated November 5, 2020'. These prices are at least six years old, so publishing them as the current menu would be misleading; they could at most support a price-free list of dishes if the reviewer accepts a directory source. Existing research notes also flag doubt about whether the restaurant is still operating. Recommend calling (708) 547-4625 or getting a photo of the in-store menu.
